_tool_description: Cheap model-selection check that returns a routing recommendation WITHOUT executing the task. Call this when you only need to know which model and provider would be chosen (for UI feedback, cost planning, or logging) and will call route_task separately for actual execution. Much faster than route_task because it uses a heuristic scoring model with no LLM API calls. Returns structured JSON with costClass, providerId, modelId and reason — same shape as route_task but content is always empty.
